name: Stage 36:3: Fada kvarn to Bergshammar
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 36:3, Fada kvarn to Bergshammar.
utilities: Fada kvarn has very limited parking for a few cars and a nearby bus stop, but official notes say buses stop at Fada less often. Tunakorset is the more reliable Fada-side public-transport access, about 1-1.5 km by road.

At the Bergshammar end, the practical endpoint is the stage 44 junction rather than Bergshammar village center. Bergshammar kyrka and Bergshammar bus stops are about 1.3-1.4 km north of the trail junction.

Nearby off-route services include Broby Bed & Breakfast and Palstorps Hage on the Kiladalen side, plus Tuna Motell, AutoMat Svalsta and Rasta Nyköpingsbro as farther service options. Treat them as deliberate detours, not stage facilities.
waterSources: No verified potable water source was found directly on stage 36:3. Carry water.
The Bergshammar spring/drinking-water point is on stage 44 about 1 km east of the 36:3 junction; show it only as continuation context and verify/treat before relying on it.
Fada dam/stream water and other natural water along the stage are not verified potable sources.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Current official Sörmlandsleden distance is 5.5 km, Naturkartan lists about 5.3 km, and the local route geometry measures about 5.18 km, so the drawn line looks broadly plausible. Older long-distance-passport, OSM tag and blog sources sometimes list 6.5 km; treat that as stale unless reverified.

This is a Fada-to-Bergshammar connector into stage 44, not a continuation toward the coastal Tunaberg stages. The local endpoint is the stage 44 junction west/southwest of Bergshammar village; snap topology to OSM node 914036955 at 58.729103,16.911059 rather than Bergshammar village center.
No current official fault report was found on the stage page during the 2026-04-27 research pass, and Naturkartan API status did not show a closure or trail-status report.

Route character: short and officially easy, but varied. The stage leaves Fada kvarn through lush Fadabäcken creek ravines, crosses/skirts wet stream features, climbs to Jätteberget, then follows higher ground with views across Kiladalen, Kilaån and toward Bergshammar church.
Jätteberget is described by Sörmlandsleden as 72.5 m above sea level and has World War II air-watch history.

Nya Stigar, Fadarundan comments and local walking notes add useful wet-weather caution: ravines/descents near Fada, steps, bridge/fords and board/plank sections can be muddy, slippery, erosion-prone, awkward with dogs, or affected by beaver activity.
Fada kvarn is a heritage/rest point, but do not imply guaranteed interior access or flowing waterfall: local reports say the mill may be locked and the fall can be dry at times.

No shelter, toilet, fireplace, shop, drinking water, or confirmed campsite was found directly on stage 36:3. Camping follows allemansrätten unless local signs or nearby protected-area rules say otherwise, and fires should not be made on moss, peat, rock slabs or outside safe/permitted places.

No named nature reserve was confirmed on the core Stage 36:3 corridor. Nearby Berga kulle is off-route context only; if shown, keep its stricter rules separate: no tenting, no fires, no riding, no motor vehicles, and no damaging trees/dead wood.

facilities.name: Fada kvarn
facilities.description: Historic mill/forge and dam-system site, official start of stage 36:3 and connection from stage 36:2. Official text describes old dam/waterfall and de Besche crown-works history; do not imply guaranteed interior access or flowing waterfall.

facilities.name: Fada kvarn parking
facilities.description: Very limited parking for a few cars across/by the road; official Fadarundan note says park diagonally and mentions an alternate gravel parking area about 1 km onward. Avoid disturbing nearby residents.

facilities.name: Fada bus stop
facilities.description: Closest paired stop to the start, essentially at Fada kvarn, but buses stop here less often according to official notes and OSM shows no shelter. North-side paired stop is at about 58.729086,16.841446; verify live service.

facilities.name: Tunakorset bus stop
facilities.description: Officially recommended public-transport access for Fada from Nyköping busstation: about 23 minutes by bus, then roughly 15 minutes / 1 km road walk in official wording. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken service.

facilities.name: Harsta korset bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative bus access in the Fada/Harsta corridor, roughly 1.5 km from Fada depending on route; verify current service.

facilities.name: Fada creek ravines
facilities.description: Approximate early-stage Fadabäcken ravine area: lush leafy stream ravines with fast-flowing water, old mill remains, dead wood and shade flora. Older hiker reports mention mud, slippery descents, erosion and possible beaver effects after wet weather.

facilities.name: Fada ravine bridge and ford
facilities.description: Early ravine/stream section around Fadabäcken has mapped bridge/ford context nearby. Treat as a wet-crossing/slip caution after rain, especially with dogs; not a drinking-water refill.

facilities.name: Jätteberget viewpoint and old air-watch site
facilities.description: Approximate high point/view area after the climb; official text places Jätteberget after about 1 km, at 72.5 m, with World War II air-watch history. The climb can feel harder than the green/easy label suggests.

facilities.name: Kiladalen ridge view
facilities.description: Representative marker for the higher rock-slab/ledge segment with views across Kilaån and Kiladalen. Treat as scenic segment context rather than one exact viewpoint.

facilities.name: Kiladalen bench-tree viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate late-stage rest/viewpoint. Stage notes recommend a tree shaped like a bench with views toward Bergshammar church and Kiladalen; coordinate needs field confirmation.

facilities.name: Bergshammar / stage 44 junction
facilities.description: Local route endpoint and connection to stage 44, not Bergshammar village center: right/west toward Sandstugan/Koppartorp, straight/east toward Nyköping/Lindbacke. OSM node 914036955 is the clean topology join.

facilities.name: Bergshammar spring / Stage 44 continuation
facilities.description: Stage 44 water point about 1 km east of the 36:3 junction. Show only as continuation context, not an on-stage 36:3 refill; verify seasonality/current availability and treat/filter because trail water quality is not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Bergshammar kyrka bus stop
facilities.description: Closest practical bus access from the Bergshammar end, about 1.3-1.4 km north of the route endpoint; not an endpoint facility. Verify current service.

facilities.name: Bergshammar bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative Bergshammar-side bus stop about 1.4 km from the route endpoint; likely served by the Nyköping-Björkvik corridor, but use Sörmlandstrafiken planner as canonical.

facilities.name: Bergshammar skola bus stop
facilities.description: Additional Bergshammar-side bus access east of the village, farther from the Stage 44 junction. Verify live service and do not treat as the route endpoint.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Nearest practical passenger rail station, about 9.5 km from Fada and 5.8 km from the Bergshammar/stage 44 junction; mark as far/off-route context.

facilities.name: Broby Bed & Breakfast
facilities.description: Nearby B&B listed by Sörmlandsleden for stages 36:2/36:3/44, roughly 1 km from the broader branch/Stage 44 area depending on access. Book ahead.

facilities.name: Palstorps Hage / Palstorp
facilities.description: Off-route seasonal activity and lodging context near Kiladalen, with bookable tree tents/hammock room/tent spots and kiosk/cafe context. Verify current operation before relying on it.

facilities.name: Berga kulle off-route reserve
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route reserve west of the stage corridor with Kiladalen views. Do not merge its rules into core Stage 36:3: inside the reserve, no tenting, no fires, no riding/motor vehicles and no damaging trees/dead wood.

facilities.name: Tuna Motell
facilities.description: Off-route lodging/service in the Svalsta/Fada corridor; useful planning context but not a trail facility.

facilities.name: AutoMat Svalsta
facilities.description: Off-route unmanned grocery/service context near Svalsta. Useful only with a planned detour; verify current operation and hours.

facilities.name: Rasta Nyköpingsbro
facilities.description: Restaurant/service area about 2.3 km from the stage 44 junction by straight line; mark as off-route context.

facilities.name: Rasta Nyköpingsbro toilets
facilities.description: Toilets at the off-route E4 service area; useful only if deliberately detouring.
